speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: The Ministry of Health’s (MOH's) vision is for all Singaporeans to live well and live long, with peace of mind.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: MOH's first priority is to help Singaporeans stay healthy.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We have promoted healthier food and lifestyle choices, encouraged disease screening, and declared War on Diabetes.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will expand these efforts and embark on new ones to move towards the goal of developing health promoting communities.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Singaporeans will be empowered through information, technology and smart behavioural nudges to eat healthily, keep active and take charge of their health, while industries and employers will be encouraged to provide supportive environments for healthy behaviour.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will also explore measures to further discourage unhealthy habits, such as smoking and excessive sugar consumption.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: To continue to safeguard public health in Singapore in the face of increased globalisation and emergence of new diseases, MOH will enhance our surveillance, preparedness and response on infectious diseases.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: The upcoming National Centre for Infectious Diseases will serve as a focal point for these efforts.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: MOH will also lead in the implementation of a National Anti-Microbial Resistance Plan to prevent the emergence and spread of drug-resistant micro-organisms.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Our hospitals will also partner primary care and community care providers to bring about seamless care for patients.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: A new Healthcare Services legislation will be enacted to enhance regulatory clarity, strengthen governance and safeguard patient safety and welfare.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: The National Electronic Health Record will improve the continuity of care for patients.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Beyond increasing capacity, we will transform care models.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: The new MOH Office for Healthcare Transformation will work with healthcare institutions to experiment with innovative and potentially game-changing concepts.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: New models will be tested, with successful ones scaled up.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will also deepen our efforts to develop Regional Health Systems, which will spearhead the development of new capabilities, such as community nursing and successful programmes that shift the nexus of care beyond the hospital to the community.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will selectively deploy regulatory sandboxes to facilitate experimentation in new services and innovative care models while ensuring patient safety.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Beyond ensuring good quality care, we will strive towards helping Singaporeans make better choices.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: To support healthcare professionals, patients and the public in making more informed and appropriate decisions, the Agency for Care Effectiveness will expand their range of education, advisory products and programmes beyond Drug Guidances and Appropriate Care Guides.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: To encourage more appropriate consumption of healthcare, MOH will publish fee benchmarks for medical procedures and services and has also introduced co-payment requirements for new Integrated Shield Plan Riders.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will continue our push for productivity improvements.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: A new agency will be set up to consolidate the procurement and supply chain functions across our public healthcare clusters.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: This will bring about better economies of scale and enable us to develop new models and capabilities that improve efficiency and benefit patients.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: MOH is also working with public hospitals to share information and practices that can enhance patient outcomes while managing costs.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Such a value-driven care approach would help raise and maintain clinical quality across our hospitals in a cost-effective manner.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will press on with the implementation of the Action Plan for Successful Ageing.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: This includes efforts to expand community-based care facilities and experiment with new forms of housing for more accessible care.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will develop social nodes in the community to bring active ageing, preventive health, functional health screening and other programmes to the doorsteps of seniors.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: MOH will continue to build a strong local pipeline of healthcare professionals.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: We will create good job opportunities for Singaporeans in the growing healthcare sector and enable our healthcare workforce to stay relevant through skills upgrading.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: For nurses, who constitute the largest group in our healthcare workforce, we will invest in a comprehensive Continuing Education and Training system and, in particular, build up capabilities for nurse-led, community-based care.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: The transformation of our healthcare system will only be possible with the combined efforts of public and private healthcare institutions, voluntary welfare organisations and other agencies.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: It would require the involvement of patients, healthcare professionals, healthcare insurers, employers and the Government.

speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Gan Kim Yong)
text: Together, we can achieve Better Health, Better Care and Better Life for all.
